title: List Filtering
description: Loop through a list and print only the numbers greater than 3.

starter_files.content:
numbers = [1, 4, 2, 6]
# Print only numbers greater than 3

learning_objectives: Combine a for loop with an if statement.
Use a condition to filter list values.
hints: Loop through each number in numbers.
Print only when the current number is greater than 3.
